---
name: 📄 Proposal
about: Propose a design or a larger change and open it for discussion before implementation
title: '[PROPOSAL]'
labels: 'proposal, untriaged'
assignees: ''
---

**What kind of change are you proposing?**
A one line summary. If the proposal changes the plugin's design at the level described in [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/lawofcycles/lance-opensearch/blob/main/docs/architecture.md), say which component or request path it touches.

**Problem Statement**
Describes the issue or challenge that needs to be addressed.

**Current State**
Explains the existing behaviour and its shortcomings, with pointers into the code or the docs.

**Proposal**
Summarizes the suggested solution or improvement.

**Approach**
Details the steps or strategy to implement the proposal, including the settings, REST endpoints or mapping types it adds or changes.

**Alternatives**
Alternatives considered, including ones that partially or temporarily solve the problem.

**Implementation Discussion**
Open questions on the proposed implementation. Design questions that concern the RFC rather than this repository belong on [opensearch-project/OpenSearch#22643](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/issues/22643).
